title: Make ViewConfigPanel description field editable
body:
Description row was rendered as a read-only `<span>`. Replace with an `<Input>` wired to `updateDraft('description', ...)`, matching the title field pattern.

- `objectDef.description` used as placeholder text
- Draft state flows through the same `updateDraft` → `onViewUpdate` pipeline as all other fields

```tsx
<ConfigRow label={t('console.objectView.description')}>
    <Input
        data-testid="view-description-input"
        className="h-7 text-xs w-32 text-right"
        value={draft.description ?? ''}
        placeholder={objectDef.description || t('console.objectView.noDescription')}
        onChange={(e) => updateDraft('description', e.target.value)}
    />
</ConfigRow>
```

Tests updated: existing read-only assertions replaced with placeholder/input checks, new test for edit interaction + `onViewUpdate` callback.

> 3. 修改 description draft 无法生效

> - description 的 value 提取自 draft.description 而不是 objectDef

> - 调用 updateDraft('description', value) 实时更新并透传给 onViewUpdate
> - 保持与 title input 行一致的交互体验

> - 可编辑描述字段（支持空和英文、中文多种字符）
